description: Check one web page's on-page SEO as MakerRadar's free SEO checker does: title and description length, one H1, canonical, language, indexing, Open Graph, structured data, image alt text and readable text — each check pass / improve / fix with how to fix it. It fetches that one page as our crawler (MakerRadarBot), after the site's robots.txt, and stores nothing; what it reads from the page is the site's own, unverified. Cached ten minutes; at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

url.description: The public page to check (https://…). A bare host means its homepage.

name: check_page_seo

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is, where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.

title: Check a page's SEO
